name: Riverside Veterinary Clinic front desk

operators.name: RegisterPatient
operators.precondition: owner refers to an existing Owner; name is non-empty; species is one of Dog, Cat, Rabbit, Bird, Ferret; age is an integer strictly between 0 and 30.
operators.effect: Creates a new Patient with the given name, species and age, and sets its ownedBy relation to owner.

operators.name: ScheduleAppointment
operators.precondition: patient refers to an existing Patient; reason is non-empty.
operators.effect: Creates a new Appointment with status 'scheduled', empty notes, sets its 'for' relation to patient. The appointment has no 'with' (vet) relation yet.

operators.name: AssignVet
operators.precondition: appointment refers to an existing Appointment whose status is 'scheduled' or 'checked_in'; vet refers to an existing Vet whose onDuty attribute is true.
operators.effect: Sets the appointment's 'with' relation to vet (replacing any previous vet assignment).

operators.name: CheckIn
operators.precondition: appointment refers to an existing Appointment whose status is 'scheduled'.

operators.name: StartExam
operators.precondition: appointment refers to an existing Appointment whose status is 'checked_in' and which has a vet assigned (a 'with' relation).

operators.name: CompleteAppointment
operators.precondition: appointment refers to an existing Appointment whose status is 'in_progress'.
operators.effect: Sets the appointment's status to 'completed' and its notes attribute to notes.

operators.name: CancelAppointment
operators.precondition: appointment refers to an existing Appointment whose status is 'scheduled' or 'checked_in'.

notes: The UI has three views reachable from the top nav: 'Clients' (owners with their patients, and the Register Patient form), 'Vets' (a table including the onDuty attribute as visible text 'Yes'/'No'), and 'Appointments' (the Schedule Appointment form plus a table of all appointments with contextual action controls: an inline vet picker + Assign button, Check In, Start Exam, a notes field + Complete, and Cancel; each control is shown only when the corresponding operator's status precondition can possibly hold, but the server still re-checks all preconditions). No attribute is hidden from the UI. onDuty is never changed by any operator in this build; it is only set at reset time, so it is a fixed constraint the learner can observe by trying AssignVet against an off-duty vet.
